sweat-rate-range.label: Whole-body sweat rate of athletes
sweat-rate-range.value: typically about 0.5–2.0 L·h⁻¹; above 3.0 L·h⁻¹ is rare

sweat-sodium-range.label: Sweat sodium concentration
sweat-sodium-range.value: about 10–90 mmol·L⁻¹ local; about 10–70 mmol·L⁻¹ whole body

body-water-split.label: Body water by compartment, as a share of body mass
body-water-split.value: about 60% in all: 40% inside cells, 15% between cells, 5% in plasma

hypohydration-threshold.label: Body mass loss used as the hypohydration threshold in guidelines
hypohydration-threshold.value: 2% of body mass (1 kg lost ≈ 1 L of water)

eah-threshold.label: Blood sodium that defines exercise-associated hyponatraemia
eah-threshold.value: below 135 mmol·L⁻¹, during or up to 24 h after exercise
